description: Generated citation-graph outputs that are too large to commit. They are byte-identical to the files at the pinned commit of the source repository. Fetch and verify them with `python -m research.literature.fetch_large`; they are written to the git-ignored research/literature/generated/large/ directory, where build_citation_artifacts and the literature tests look for them.

urlCheck.result: The raw.githubusercontent.com URLs below return HTTP 200 with the exact Content-Length and serve bytes whose SHA-256 matches. Both files are ordinary git blobs (not Git LFS) at the pinned commit, so media.githubusercontent.com returns 404; https://github.com/<repository>/raw/<commit>/<path> redirects (302) to the same raw URL.
